newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kansai Elec reduces plant power for checks.
newsitem.headline: Kansai Elec reduces plant power for checks.

text.p: Kansai Electric Power Co Inc said on Wednesday that its 826,000-kilowatt Takahama nuclear plant had been reduced to 75 percent power to allow the firm to check the cause of unusual water levels in the system.
A company spokesman said there had been a higher-than-usual drainage of water from the plant's high-pressure feed water heater.
Water drained from the system, which usually amounts to 7.3 million tonnes an hour, had increased to 7.5 million tonnes, he said.
The cause of a similar incident in January last year was a hole in the heater, the spokesman said, adding the firm believed the cause this time could be the same.
He said the the power reduction could continue for a few days until the investigation was completed.
There was no danger of radiation leaking into the environment as a result of the problem, he said.
